candidates.change_summary: Remove the require statement that checks msg.value == 10 ether, allowing calls with any value to proceed.
Remove the require statement that checks block.timestamp > pastBlockTime, allowing multiple calls in the same block.
Change the required msg.value from 10 ether to 1 wei.
Change the condition in the if statement from block.number % 15 == 0 to block.number % 15 != 0, reversing when the balance is transferred.
Remove the transfer call inside the if block, so the contract never sends its balance to the caller.
Change the divisor in the modulo operation from 15 to 7.
